async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the searchbox to filter projects by name 'solarized-prism-theme'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name...')
    await searchbox.fill('solarized-prism-theme')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')  # Trigger the filter, common in GitLab
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Step 2: Wait a bit for the UI to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # 2 seconds to ensure results load
    # Step 3: Click the link for 'solarized-prism-theme' if it appears
    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='solarized-prism-theme', exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    # After clicking, the page will navigate to the project details
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
